Here are some of the leading office furniture brand websites, categorized by their specialties (premium, mid-range, budget-friendly, ergonomic, modular, etc.):

### **Premium/Luxury Office Furniture Brands**
1. **Herman Miller** – [www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)
   - Known for: Aeron Chair, Eames designs, high-end ergonomic furniture
2. **Steelcase** – [www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)
   - Known for: Gesture Chair, Flex collection, workplace innovation
3. **Haworth** – [www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)
   - Known for: Zody Chair, modular workstations, sustainable designs
4. **Knoll** – [www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)
   - Known for: Modern office furniture, Ludwig Mies van der Rohe designs
5. **Vitra** – [www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)
   - Known for: High-end European design, Panton Chair, Eames Lounge

### **Mid-Range & Commercial Office Furniture**
6. **IKEA (Office Section)** – [www.ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com)
   - Known for: Affordable, modular desks (BEKANT, IDÅSEN), storage solutions
7. **Branches (by HNI Corp)** – [www.branches.com](https://www.branches.com)
   - Known for: Affordable office desks, file cabinets, and chairs
8. **Global Furniture Group** – [www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com)
   - Known for: Modern office desks, conference tables, seating
9. **Kimball Office** – [www.kimballoffice.com](https://www.kimballoffice.com)
   - Known for: Workspace solutions, collaboration furniture
10. **Allsteel** – [www.allsteeloffice.com](https://www.allsteeloffice.com)
   - Known for: Sustainable office furniture, high-quality seating

### **Ergonomic & Adjustable Furniture Specialists**
11. **Fully (formerly Ergo Depot)** – [www.fully.com](https://www.fully.com)
   - Known for: Jarvis Standing Desk, ergonomic chairs
12. **Uplift Desk** – [www.upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com)
   - Known for: Customizable standing desks, anti-fatigue mats
13. **FlexiSpot** – [www.flexispot.com](https://www.flexispot.com)
   - Known for: Affordable standing desks, monitor arms
14. **Vari** – [www.vari.com](https://www.vari.com)
   - Known for: Electric standing desks, active office solutions
15. **HumanCentric** – [www.humancentric.com](https://www.humancentric.com)
   - Known for: Ergonomic chairs, height-adjustable desks

### **Budget-Friendly & Online Retailers**
16. **Amazon Business** – [www.amazon.com/business](https://www.amazon.com/business)
   - Known for: Wide variety of office furniture (brands like Sauder, Bush Furniture)
17. **Wayfair (Office Section)** – [www.wayfair.com](https://www.wayfair.com)
   - Known for: Affordable desks, chairs, and storage
18. **-office** – [www.office.com](https://www.office.com) (Note: Not Microsoft Office, but a furniture retailer)
   - Known for: Discounted office furniture, closeout deals
19. **Office Max / Office Depot** – [www.officedepot.com](https://www.officedepot.com)
   - Known for: Basic office furniture, supplies
20. **Staples** – [www.staples.com](https://www.staples.com)
   - Known for: Budget-friendly desks, chairs, and storage

### **Sustainable & Eco-Friendly Brands**
21. **Bureaux** – [www.bureaux.com](https://www.bureaux.com)
   - Known for: Sustainable, minimalist office furniture
22. **Eastside Co. (by Branch)** – [www.eastsideco.com](https://www.eastsideco.com)
   - Known for: Eco-conscious standing desks and chairs
23. **Architectural Mailboxes (for home offices)** – [www.archmailboxes.com](https://www.archmailboxes.com)
   - Known for: High-end home office desks

### **Modular & Custom Office Furniture**
24. **Interion** – [www.interion.com](https://www.interion.com)
   - Known for: Custom office workstations, benching systems
25. **KI (Krueger International)** – [www.ki.com](https://www.ki.com)
   - Known for: Educational and corporate modular furniture
26. **Paoli** – [www.paolicompany.com](https://www.paolicompany.com)
   - Known for: Luxury executive and conference furniture

### **European & International Brands**
27. **OKamura (Japan)** – [www.okamura.co.jp](https://www.okamura.co.jp)
   - Known for: High-quality ergonomic chairs (Pro Flex, Contessa)
28. **Sedus (Germany)** – [www.sedus.com](https://www.sedus.com)
   - Known for: Swop Chair, sustainable office seating
29. **Nowy Styl (Poland)** – [www.nowystyl.com](https://www.nowystyl.com)
   - Known for: Affordable European office chairs
30. **Kinnarps (Sweden)** – [www.kinnarps.com](https://www.kinnarps.com)
   - Known for: Scandinavian office design, flexible workspaces

### **Industrial & Heavy-Duty Office Furniture**
31. **HON (by HNI Corp)** – [www.hon.com](https://www.hon.com)
   - Known for: Durable, commercial-grade office furniture
32. **Bush Furniture** – [www.bushfurniture.com](https://www.bushfurniture.com)
   - Known for: Affordable, sturdy desks and storage
33. **Sauder** – [www.sauder.com](https://www.sauder.com)
   - Known for: Budget-friendly, ready-to-assemble office furniture

### **Luxury Executive & Conference Furniture**
34. **BAC office** – [www.bac-office.com](https://www.bac-office.com)
   - Known for: High-end executive desks and conference tables
35. **DARRAN Furniture** – [www.darran.com](https://www.darran.com)
   - Known for: Custom luxury office furniture
36. **Nucraft** – [www.nucraft.com](https://www.nucraft.com)
   - Known for: Premium executive desks and credenzas

### **Where to Compare & Buy**
- **Contract Furniture Dealers** (for bulk/commercial orders):
  - [Branch](https://www.branchfurniture.com)
  - [Director’s Office](https://www.directorsoffice.com)
  - [BTOD.com](https://www.btod.com) (for ergonomic chairs & desks)

Would you like recommendations based on a specific need (e.g., standing desks, executive offices, home offices, or bulk corporate orders)?
